name: Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge
core_rationale: High western ceramic-bell ridge of Continent 01 where Sola's shield-rim arches hang thousands of hollow terracotta wind-pipes that sing when thermal breezes rise.
local_conflict: Breeze-piping clay sprites and bell-crest finches nest inside the resonant ceramic wind-organs.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Lantern-Keepers say that when the evening breeze blows through Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge, the clay pipes play Sola's ancient lullaby across the entire basin.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Glazed terracotta arches along the western shield-rim hung with thousands of swaying ceramic bell-pipes.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What carillon sanctuary crowns the highest arch of Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the western acoustic rim of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed terracotta arches hung with thousands of singing ceramic wind-pipes.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m ceramic colonnade walkways, 0.58m wind-organ benches, and 0.14m terracotta risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Chime-Pipe Colonnade and Carillon Belfry.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-chime-pipe-colonnade as a Mystery frontier.
